name: UNFI - Vernon CA DC (Los Angeles / Albert's Organics West)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed. Albert's Organics West Division (UNFI Fresh produce/specialty distributor) at 2724 Leonis Blvd, Vernon, CA 90058. Address geocoded ROOFTOP to 33.99958,-118.22139; Street View at heading 180 from the road pano shows the building street number '2724' on the office facade, positively confirming identity. Locked building center ~33.99940,-118.22170 (a single warehouse south of Leonis Blvd).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. This is a dense Vernon (LA industrial core) infill parcel; the warehouse meets the street with an open driveway and dock apron. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible at z19-z20 satellite or in Street View along Leonis Blvd.
fieldNotes.guardShack: None. No booth structure at any driveway. remoteGs=false because there is no gate.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - an active rail spur curves along the building's south and west edges, a legacy Vernon industrial siding running right against the warehouse wall.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 dock doors estimated along the east face of the building facing a small paved court; band 10-25. Refrigerated produce DC - large rooftop refrigeration condenser units (banks of circular evaporator fans) confirm a reefer facility.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Tight urban site - dock apron holds only 1-2 trucks deep; no room for a 3-truck queue.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Leonis Blvd is a busy Vernon arterial; any truck queue at the dock apron would back directly onto the public road / sidewalk with negligible stacking room.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Minimal - a small east-side yard fits a handful of parked trailers; no dedicated drop lot. Estimate 0-10.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~4 acres - compact single-building parcel; the perimeter box is an estimate, this is a tightly-built infill lot with no fenced setback.
